sources.title: Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B is a lightweight video creation and editing model built by Wan-AI that handles multiple video generation tasks through a single unified architecture. The model uses a DiT (Diffusion Transformer) backbone with a custom video VAE for encoding and decoding, and integrates with the Diffusers library for straightforward inference.
